title: #CaliforniansForAll College Corps
sponsor: California Volunteers, Office of the Governor
pay_text: Up to $10,000 pre-tax for 450 hours of service
who_text: Full-time undergraduates at a participating California campus who are U.S. citizens, nationals, permanent residents, or AB 540 eligible, and who work to pay for school or show financial need
description: You serve 450 hours over a school year with your campus or a local nonprofit, helping with K-12 education, climate action, or food insecurity. You get a living allowance during the year and education awards when you finish. You apply through your own college's College Corps program.

title: California Climate Action Corps Fellowship
sponsor: California Volunteers, Office of the Governor
pay_text: Up to $35,250 living allowance (before taxes) over 11 months
who_text: People at least 18 years old with a high school diploma or equivalent
description: A full-time, 11-month service fellowship from September through August where you lead climate projects in California communities. Fellows serve 1,700 hours and receive a living allowance plus training.

title: Capital Fellows Programs
sponsor: Sacramento State, Center for California Studies
pay_text: Paid full-time work for 10 to 11 months, with medical, dental and vision benefits
who_text: People who will have a completed bachelor's degree and be at least 20 years old by September 1 of the fellowship year
description: Fellows work full time in California state government in Sacramento, in the Assembly, Senate, executive branch, or courts. The 2027-2028 fellowships last 10 to 11 months and include paid work and health benefits.
